sloka: ह्रस्वो रूक्षोऽप्रशस्तश्च परिवेषस्तु लोहितः ।आदित्ये विमले वीलम् लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते ॥६-२३-९॥।।
transliteration: hrasvo rūkṣo'praśastaśca pariveṣastu lohitaḥ ।āditye vimale vīlam lakṣma lakṣmaṇa dṛśyate ॥6-23-9॥।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana the white Sun is appearing in copper colour around with black colour in the centre which had not been seen before. It is small and dreary."
